entities.summary: The Uzbekistan Liberal Democratic Party, officially the Movement of Entrepreneurs and Businessmen – Uzbekistan Liberal Democratic Party, is a political party in Uzbekistan and the country's ruling party. The four other parties in the Oliy Majlis, Uzbekistan's parliament, are pro-government. Its rule has been described as authoritarian.
